title: exportSelectionToPdf
description: Exports the ordered selection to PDF or flattened JPG page payloads and posts progress/result messages to the UI via the provided post callback.

params.name: msg
params.description: Export options: mode ('vector'|'flatten'), merge (boolean), order (string[] of node ids).

params.name: post
params.description: Callback used to send progress and result messages to the UI (e.g. sendToUi or figma.ui.postMessage wrapper).

returns.description: Resolves when all pages are exported and the final message is posted. Does not return page data directly.
